title: Small town bands: the Bogalusa Rhythm Aces
summary: He compares small southern bands to New Orleans and recalls the kids' band he started in Bogalusa.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now you seem to have gotten around the country a lot more than a lot of the fellas, at least that are still there. I wondered, you've probably heard a lot of other small bands all over the south there. Oh yeah. How did they compare with New Orleans? Did they have about the same style or did they seem to...

Oh they played good. We had a little gang of kids there in Bogalusa, Louisiana to play nice. The Rhythm Aces they called them. The fact of the business I started one or two boys out with the, you know, the founder of the band. Yeah. Willie Esther and among them.
Do you remember anybody else in that band? What?
The Bogalusa band? Oh yeah. They had Hanson Sevier. He was a good piano player. He used to be piano player in the band. Well some of the boys I just remember their names.
Yeah. Some of those fellas might still be up there though.
